title: Agon: The Bible Challenge Roadmap
subtitle: Visual roadmap generated from GitHub milestones and ROADMAP.md (snapshot 2026-09-28, Agon vNext / ADR-001).
readingNote: Read this left to right: each step is an intended sequence bucket, not a calendar date. The design system and #507 can run in parallel with M0; M5/M6 start once #510 proves the first vNext surfaces and grow alongside M4. 1.0 is the first release-quality Local vNext product; % of games migrated is tracked as a metric (0 of 32 on 2026-09-28), not a release gate. Native GitHub blockedBy links are the source of truth.

phases.title: Testing, Host Mode, Host Remote
phases.dependency: Shipped. Legacy runtime runs all 32 implemented GameIds.

phases.title: Agon Brand & Design System
phases.dependency: Renderer-agnostic; #117 rename continuity blocks #99. Feeds vNext surfaces.

phases.title: vNext Architecture Foundation
phases.dependency: Needs ADR-001 (#512, merged). Exit: minimal GameDefinition runs without Electron/renderer/network; legacy games still launch; CI enforces boundaries.

phases.title: vNext Reference Migration
phases.dependency: Five Clues end-to-end (fallback Name That Book). Needs #509, #402, #4, #516.

phases.title: Catalog & Migration Classification
phases.dependency: #511 needs #507 and #510. Output creates M4 wave and M3 capability issues.

phases.title: Core Capability Extraction
phases.issues: Cards, randomizers, timer, image board, board play, race, journey, relationships
phases.dependency: Engines/capabilities on Engine SDK #447; each names its consumers.

phases.title: Existing Game Migration Waves
phases.dependency: Waves by capability family; legacy variants #56-#58, #87 land after their wave.

phases.title: Renderer / Experience Decomposition
phases.dependency: Starts after #510/#516; no giant App.tsx rewrite.

phases.title: Controller & Shared/LAN Contracts
phases.dependency: Absorbs 0.4.0 Phone Mode Stage 1; controllers use vNext intents, not WebSocket details.

phases.title: Stabilization (Local vNext product)
phases.dependency: M0 + M1, design system, local controllers on vNext, save/resume, CI/regression/package green, representative migrated families.

phases.title: Tournaments & Persistent Events
phases.dependency: Needs #353 persistence and #364 ledger; #197 needs M4.

phases.title: Packaging, Distribution & Entitlements
phases.dependency: Older/newer duplicates must be reconciled first; needs M0 content contract.

phases.title: Themed Content & Seasonal Packs
phases.dependency: Content-only work is allowed under the legacy freeze; pack model #24 is in Packaging.

phases.title: New General Agon Catalog on vNext
phases.issues: Baseball, Blockbusters, Pairs of Faith, Wayfinder, Multitude, ...
phases.dependency: Never targets the legacy engine; grouping via track:* labels.

phases.title: Agon Kids on vNext
phases.dependency: Separate AGON_KIDS family; shares infrastructure, never GameDefinitions.

phases.title: Legacy Retirement
phases.dependency: Every retained game migrated or superseded; then delete gameEngine.ts path.

phases.title: Platform Hardening & Operations
phases.dependency: Diagnostics, replay, size budgets, docs publishing, localization.

phases.title: General + Kids Candidates, Testing
phases.dependency: Candidates leave the backlog only through a #507 disposition into M7/M8.
